usedFor: Developers use Google Cloud Pub/Sub to route messages, starting with “Create PubSub Topic” to receive them.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Updated” in Shopify, then “Create PubSub Topic” in Google Cloud Pub/Sub
bestTemplate.why: An updated product can open a topic where messages are received and routed.

watchOut: “Create PubSub Topic” makes a topic each time it runs, so run it only when a new topic is wanted.
